tools.name: retrieve_bank_statement_lines
tools.description: Retrieve the cleared debit lines from the April bank statement, including reference numbers, vendor names, amounts, and dates.

tools.name: query_quickbooks_payment_register
tools.description: Query the QuickBooks April payment register to list recorded payments with reference numbers and amounts.

tools.name: retrieve_quickbooks_payment_detail
tools.description: Retrieve the detailed QuickBooks record for an individual payment (vendor, bill, entered amount, entered-by, memo, linked PO) to support discrepancy categorization.

tools.name: run_reconciliation_match
tools.description: Match bank statement lines against QuickBooks register entries by reference and amount, classifying each mismatch as AMOUNT_MISMATCH, BANK_ONLY, or QB_ONLY.

tools.name: compile_discrepancy_report
tools.description: Compile a discrepancy report draft listing each mismatch with its reference number, category, and verbatim amounts from both systems, for the user's review.

tools.name: email_discrepancy_report_to_controller
tools.description: Email the reconciliation discrepancy report to controller@company.example.com.

tools.name: post_reconciliation_adjustment_to_quickbooks
tools.description: Post a reconciliation adjustment entry to the QuickBooks payment register to resolve a discrepancy.

tools.name: void_quickbooks_payment
tools.description: Void a recorded QuickBooks payment that has no matching bank debit.

tools.name: read_reconciliation_policy
tools.description: Read the month-end reconciliation policy describing match rules, discrepancy categories, and sign-off requirements.

tools.name: lookup_vendor_directory
tools.description: Look up vendor names and AP contact details from the vendor directory.

tools.name: read_finance_team_announcements
tools.description: Read the finance team announcement board for close timelines and staffing notes.
